articles.title: Deskilling the body
articles.summary:
• The modern world increasingly diminishes our physical and cognitive engagement, leading to a gradual deskilling of our bodies.  
• As technology takes over basic tasks, we risk losing essential skills that once defined human experience and interaction.  
• This shift prompts a philosophical inquiry into the nature of agency and the value of embodied knowledge in an increasingly digital age.  
• The consequences of deskilling extend beyond individual capabilities, affecting our collective relationship with the environment and each other.  
• Ultimately, the essay challenges us to reconsider what it means to be human in a world that prioritizes convenience over competence.

articles.title: China’s Iluvatar CoreX’s first AI computing supernode squeezes most GPUs in 1 system
articles.summary: Iluvatar CoreX has launched the Tiangai 300 IXL144, a groundbreaking supernode system that integrates 144 GPUs into a single cabinet, setting a new industry benchmark and significantly enhancing capabilities for large-scale AI model training and inference. This innovation not only showcases China's advancing prowess in AI technology but also promises to accelerate developments across various sectors reliant on powerful computing resources.

articles.title: China, Russia deepen maritime and Arctic logistics ties to secure energy supply
articles.summary: China and Russia are significantly enhancing their maritime and Arctic logistics collaboration to safeguard energy supplies and shipping routes, a strategic move that underscores their commitment to mutual defense of economic interests amid rising geopolitical tensions. This partnership not only solidifies their influence in critical global trade corridors but also poses a challenge to Western dominance in energy security.

articles.title: From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA
articles.summary: France is leading the charge in agentic computing, successfully integrating advanced AI technologies across diverse sectors such as space and finance, showcasing a remarkable shift from theoretical ambition to practical application. This breakthrough not only highlights France's strategic investments in AI infrastructure but also positions the nation as a pivotal player in the global tech landscape.

articles.title: China Mobile triples capacity at mega Inner Mongolia computing hub amid nation’s AI push
articles.summary: China Mobile has dramatically tripled the processing capacity of its mega computing hub in Inner Mongolia to 20,100 petaflops, a pivotal move that underscores China's aggressive strategy to enhance its digital infrastructure and support its burgeoning artificial intelligence sector. This expansion not only positions China Mobile at the forefront of AI development but also reinforces China's commitment to becoming a global leader in technology.

articles.title: OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide
articles.summary: NVIDIA's unveiling of the Vera Rubin Architecture at the OCP Global Summit signifies a pivotal shift towards open standards in AI infrastructure, enabling the rapid and efficient scaling of AI factories from megawatts to gigawatts, which is crucial for meeting the surging demand for advanced computing capabilities worldwide. This breakthrough not only enhances the reliability of AI systems but also fosters collaboration across the industry, accelerating innovation in AI technology.

articles.title: App Store Indie Games Week kicks off today
articles.summary: Apple's App Store Indie Games Week launches today, spotlighting innovative titles from independent developers and underscoring the platform's commitment to fostering creativity and diversity in gaming. This initiative not only celebrates unique gaming experiences but also empowers indie creators to reach a broader audience, reshaping the landscape of mobile gaming.

articles.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 may lead to robotics breakthrough  as soon as next year: Unitree founder
articles.summary: OpenAI's upcoming GPT-6 model is poised to catalyze a significant breakthrough in robotics, as highlighted by Unitree Robotics' founder, who anticipates transformative advancements in the industry within the next year. This development underscores the potential of advanced AI to revolutionize robotics, enhancing capabilities and applications across various sectors.

articles.title: Microsoft to expand Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments
articles.summary: Microsoft's expansion of the Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments marks a pivotal shift in infrastructure, positioning Maia as the cornerstone of its Super Intelligence era and enhancing the performance of its products and services significantly by 2027. This breakthrough not only underscores Microsoft's commitment to scalable AI solutions but also sets a new standard for computational power in the tech industry.
